title: Best man, ii
logline: Tuesday. The thrift store. A suit for nine dollars. It fits like a suit that cost nine dollars. The dog approves of the smell.

panels.composition: A thrift store on main street. Racks. WOOD holding up a dark suit. BARNABY at the hem.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man holding up a dark suit on a hanger in a cluttered thrift store while a small dog sniffs its hem

panels.composition: The tag: $9. The sleeve: an inch short.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a nine-dollar price tag on a suit sleeve that is an inch too short

panels.composition: Wood in it, in the store's mirror. The mirror's frame: the strip draws it like a panel border, so he's a strip inside the strip.

characters.pose: in the suit, in a mirror

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man wearing a slightly short dark suit reflected in a thrift-store mirror whose frame is drawn like a comic panel border
image.notes: The mirror as a panel border. He is a strip inside the strip.

panels.composition: At the register. Nine dollars. The dog's nose in the suit's bag.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man paying at a thrift-store register while a small dog puts its nose into the suit bag

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: The nine-dollar suit (see dw_2009-09-12). 'It smells like somebody's dad.'
